text: I Have Quieted My SoulA Song of Ascents. Of David.O Yahweh, my heart is not exalted, and my eyes are not raised high;And I do not involve myself in great matters,Or in matters too marvelous for me.
Surely I have soothed and quieted my soul,Like a weaned child with his mother,Like a weaned child is my soul within me.
O Israel, wait for YahwehFrom now until forever.
